Definition: a primary word (compare G444); a man (properly as an individual male):--fellow, husband, man, sir.
BiblicalUsage: Man, husband, fellow, sir: the word covers the individual male in every relation. Joseph is called the husband of Mary, a man is to love his wife as Christ loved the church, and Peter stands up to say, ye men of Israel, hear these words.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this plain word carries the whole weight of manhood as Scripture sees it: a man is known by what he does with those given to him. Joseph's quiet righteousness, the husband's love like Christ's, the men of Israel called to listen, all of it says the same thing, that being a man means answering for others. I hold that standard, and I know it is higher than any man can meet alone.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Husband of Mary; Simon Peter; Paul
